reviews.title: guest
reviews.text: Hello,I’ve seen this app everywhere so I tried it out.I do not know if it is only me,but when I click the app it immediately kicks me out the app.Hopefully it isn’t just me.But if so please improve this error.Thank you.

reviews.title: App glitches out when you reach a certain level
reviews.text: Ive finished all the lessons in the app and only have verses to translate left and to learn all the words through the translation of the verses. It tells me I have around 2000 verses left and when I begin, I obviously cannot do all the verses in one sitting. When I quit the session it tells me my progress will be saved, but when I reenter I have to start from the beginning each time and translate the same exact verses again and again without moving forward. It’s very frustrating and I have stopped using the app because of that.

reviews.title: Cant apply changes/ keeps closing app
reviews.text:
Cant turn off translation or apply changes when trying to reas surah

It keeps closing the app when i try and take the adam test or read the next lesson on salah. I paid for the subscriptions and this is unacceptable and waste of my money

reviews.title: Love this app but why no sound?
reviews.text: This app is great but the sound does not work at all. I have tried all my settings nothing seems to work. It makes the bell sound whenever I get something right but does not read anything out loud at all no matter what I press. Please fix and I will update my review

reviews.title: app will not allow me to turn on location.
reviews.text: this app is good but it wont allow le to turn on location so that i can get accurate time for preyers. please if i can get help with this it would be great

reviews.title: No download when paying monthly premium
reviews.text: Alhamdulillah, I like the app - it is a great tool for English speaking reverts, but either the website description is incorrect or the customer service needs improvement. I contacted the app 3 times in a one month period and after getting their auto response I did communicate with real people. They asked me to send them proof & more info three times that I had paid the monthly premium, which I did, but I never got the download service or a refund, so I cancelled any future payments to them ... buyer beware ...

reviews.title: Major Glitch - Can’t Progress
reviews.text: Every time I finish a quiz, my progress resets and the same words keep repeating. I’ve deleted, updated, and emailed support—no response! Extremely frustrating since I can’t actually move forward in my learning. PLEASE fix this!!!!!

reviews.title: Quiz
reviews.text: This app is really good for learning words my only complaint is the quiz feature isn’t working it’s reset everything to new words ehen everything before was in different categories now no matter how many times I try and to practice it stays in medium or weak currently I have 0 strong words please fix this other than this is an amazing app I would recommend.
